artworks.title: The Entry into Jerusalem
artworks.description: This is a print featuring a man on a donkey beneath an archway. The man has a beard, and his head is surrounded by rays of light. He is barefoot and he is holding the reigns of the donkey, which has long ears. Around this central man are more people holding what look like tall palm fronds. One person appears to be bowing down before the man on the donkey, placing cloth on the ground. The background features the stone archway, and on the right is a sky with stylized clouds.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group seated around a table in an arched, enclosed space. There is a large lattice-patterned window in the background. Light radiates from one individual at the center of the table. Multiple figures are gathered around the table, engaged in a communal meal with dining implements and dishes visible. The style of the drawing features finely detailed lines and strong contrasts between light and dark.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure kneeling in prayer with celestial imagery. The drawing shows a figure in long robes, kneeling in the foreground amidst rocky terrain. Several figures are resting or sleeping on the ground to the figure's right. Above the kneeling figure, in the upper left of the image, a cloud formation can be seen, within which an expressive face is depicted. In the background, there are detailed trees and a rising or setting moon. The lines are fine and intricate, typical of a woodcut or engraving.

artworks.title: The Arrest of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic scene with soldiers and a burst of light. The scene is crowded with figures wearing armor, holding swords and spears, amidst a tumultuous confrontation. At the center, there's a dramatic explosion of light emanating from a torch or other light source, casting bright rays outward. The composition is dense, with a multitude of overlapping figures all enveloped in an atmosphere of tension and action. The lines are finely detailed and meticulously etched, providing a sense of movement and intensity within the scene.

artworks.title: Christ before Pilate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of armored figures in a medieval setting. The scene features figures dressed in armor, holding weapons, gathered under an archway. The drawing includes detailed lines and hatching to show texture and depth, especially in the clothing folds and archway. The composition guides the viewer's focus towards the figures' interaction, implying a moment of dialogue or confrontation. The architectural canopy on the left enhances the medieval atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Christ before Caiaphas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in animated discussion or confrontation outside a building. There are five figures visible in the scene, each dressed in varied and ornate medieval attire. The drawing is rendered in stark black-and-white, utilizing strong lines and hatching to convey form and texture. The detailed costumes include long flowing robes, belted tunics, and head coverings. There is a curtain or entranceway to a building in the background. The figures are portrayed in a compact arrangement, with overlapping limbs and garments that convey a sense of movement and interaction. The intricate linework infuses the scene with a lively, energetic feel.

artworks.title: The Flagellation of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures engaged in a scene of violence. The image shows two men attacking a third individual, who is bound to a column. The scene is detailed with black and white hatching and crosshatching techniques, and features a background with a stone or brick archway leading into another space.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures in an architectural setting. One figure is seated while two others are leaning over them with sticks or rods. The architectural elements include an arch and pillars with detailed designs. The style is reminiscent of a Renaissance woodcut, with fine lines and shading. The scene appears dynamic with a sense of tension, heightened by the expressions and postures of the figures.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an architectural setting. The drawing depicts multiple figures in an intricate scene. The setting is indoors or within a walled enclosure, with walls and an architectural structure at the top of the image. The figures are dressed in historical clothing, including robes and hats, and are engaged in an exchange or discussion. The use of lines and shading provides texture and depth to the illustration, typical of the woodcut or engraving style used in historical illustrations.

artworks.title: Pilate Washing His Hands
artworks.description: This is a drawing of armored figures gathered under a canopy. The scene shows figures wearing helmets and costumes. They are crowding under a canopy with detailed textures, and in the background, there is architecture with brickwork patterns. Pointed weapons such as spears or swords are visible, suggesting military or ceremonial activity. The drawing is monochromatic, emphasizing line and texture.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.description: The image shows a group of armored figures in front of a fortress. The figures are gathered around a large arched doorway with spiked and barred gates. Some of the figures are in dynamic poses, holding swords or staffs. The background includes a brick structure, adding to the fortress setting. The drawing is in black and white with detailed line work.

artworks.title: Christ Nailed to the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a group of figures surrounding a central horizontal nude figure. The composition includes small spears, a large tree on the right, and a distant castle in the background. Birds are seen in the sky. The style is reminiscent of woodcut art by artists like Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Raising of the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a crucifixion scene. The image shows a group of figures erecting a cross in intricate detail. The central focus is the cross with a figure affixed to it, surrounded by other figures in period-appropriate garments. Some figures seem to be supporting the cross as it is raised. The background features spears and flags held by surrounding figures, adding depth and movement to the scene. The drawing is characterized by finely etched lines that capture expressions and postures with precision.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts a central figure who is crucified on a wooden cross, with a crown of thorns on their head and a radiant halo of light emanating from behind. Below the cross, there are figures engaged in expressions of mourning, some kneeling, others bent over in despair. The scene takes place outdoors, with sparse trees and several figures in the background, some of whom appear to be carrying spears. The drawing is rendered in a woodcut style, emphasizing bold lines and high contrast between the black ink and the white background.

artworks.title: The Descent from the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures interacting with a large wooden structure. The drawing is a woodcut or engraving, characterized by bold lines and high contrast typical of this style. It shows individuals on a ladder and engaging with the wooden beams. The figures appear to be in robes and sandals. The background features a landscape with distant hills and possibly a small settlement or gathering. The composition focuses on the texture of fabrics and the structure of the wooden beams.

artworks.title: The Lamentation of Christ
artworks.description: Three figures are depicted in an outdoor setting. Two figures are standing, one figure is lying on the ground. The standing figure on the left is leaning forward, with short hair or a hood, and wearing a long garment. The standing figure on the right has curly hair, also wearing a long robe, bending over the third figure who is semi-reclined on the ground. The reclining figure has long, wavy hair, is partially clothed, with eyes closed. The background includes trees, shrubs, and mountain silhouettes under a stylized cloudy sky. The artwork is monochrome with intricate linework and shading.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures around a table-like structure in a dark, cave-like setting. The figures are covered in shadows and huddled closely, with hanging jagged formations from the ceiling. The setting appears to be secluded, possibly indicating a hidden or secretive activity. The figures' postures and expressions suggest interest or concern as they engage in a task. The art style is characterized by bold contrasts and lines.

artworks.title: Christ Descending into Hell
artworks.description: This is a drawing that features mythological elements. It includes a bearded figure with a staff or sceptre standing over another figure who is kneeling or crouching. A winged figure is positioned in the top right corner, appearing to be in mid-flight or descent. The characters are muscular and detailed, with intricate garments and wings. The drawing is framed within a square shape, and depicts a scene with dramatic lighting suggesting a pivotal moment.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.description: It is a drawing of a central figure standing on a stone slab, holding a staff or banner in its left hand. Surrounding the slab are armored figures in various poses. The composition uses strong lines and hatching for texture.

artworks.title: Noli me Tangere
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with one arm raised and holding a staff with a cross in one hand. Their detailed facial features include a beard and long hair. They are wearing a draped garment tied at the waist, leaving the chest exposed. In the background are mountains, trees, and a second person seated on the ground wearing a hat and a robe, holding a container. The seated person has a bag around their waist. The image is in black and white with shading highlighting the details. The background shows a dynamic sky with a bold pattern.

artworks.title: The Ascension of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a stone altar with an open book floating above in a cloud-filled sky. The drawing depicts several figures who appear to be looking upwards at the book which is surrounded by an abundance of clouds. The composition is filled with intricate line work. The stone altar and arrangement of figures give a sense of an important or mystical gathering, with an atmospheric mood accentuated by the swirling clouds. The artist's proficiency in capturing detailed textures and expressions is evident in the shading and cross-hatching techniques used.

artworks.title: The Death of the Virgin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered in a vaulted space. The composition features numerous figures closely huddled together, surrounded by an arched ceiling. The depiction is rich in intricate line work. The figures appear to be engrossed in an activity centered in the middle of the group, displaying a variety of robes and hair styles. The use of light and shadow is skillfully managed to guide the viewer's eye towards the central action. The architectural elements, such as the arches, contribute to the solemn atmosphere of the piece.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated, haloed figure surrounded by other figures and two cherubs. The central figure is seated on a sphere with beams of light emanating from the head. The scene includes multiple figures in various poses, either kneeling or gesturing, creating a sense of reverence. Two cherubs are depicted in the sky blowing trumpets. The artwork is rendered in a detailed, line-based engraving style typical of religious iconography that emphasizes the haloed figure as the focal point.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child on a Crescent
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright, holding a child in her arms. The child has a serene expression, and both have halos around their heads. The woman's hair flows down in loose waves, and she is dressed in garments that drape elegantly. Around them are cherubs or angels, some holding a crown above the woman's head. The background is filled with clouds, giving the scene a heavenly or supernatural atmosphere, with the figures surrounded by radiant lines.
